endpoint: mu = sum(I*m)/sum(I)/m_prec over all centroid peaks of the matched MS2 scan (precursor included, no cutoff); m_prec = theoretical [M+H]+; per (compound,rung) = median over matched scans across the compound's used wells
rung_rule: muru.wur_v2.external_msnlib.fixed_rung_scans: within a run of consecutive MS2 scans sharing one selected-ion m/z, first scan with CE=20 is rung 20, last scan (run length>=2) with CE=60 is rung 60; the Assisted scan is never used
precursor_matching: selected-ion m/z within 0.01 Da of theoretical [M+H]+; matched scan window lower limit <= 40 and upper limit >= [M+H]+ + 1
support_exclusion_rule: a compound is excluded from the primary if either model's u=(E/30)/g_hat falls outside the frozen profile's knot range at either rung (muru.wur_v2.candidate.supported)
primary_metric: P1 = pooled two-rung RMSE over all eligible compound-rung cells (muru.wur_v2.metrics.p1)

novelty_bins.reason: fixed >=0.70 similarity bin had only 6 compounds (<30 floor)

decision_rule.practically_meaningful: P1_candidate < P1_TierA AND upper-95%-bootstrap P1_ratio < 1.00 AND point ratio <= 0.95
decision_rule.modest: P1_candidate < P1_TierA AND upper-95%-bootstrap P1_ratio < 1.00 AND 0.95 < point ratio < 1.00
decision_rule.directionally_favorable_inconclusive: point ratio < 1.00 but upper-95% bootstrap interval includes 1.00
decision_rule.failed_to_transfer: point ratio >= 1.00, or a materially adverse tail effect under the frozen secondary rule
